integrity: Analytic state-space reduction, exact rational generating function and strict Lyapunov identity; reproducibility via standalone exact-algebra checker; independent audit not performed.
limitations: Exactly two scalar nodes, complete-averaging weights, gain one, independent time rounds, Bernoulli half-success marginals, zero caches and nonzero antisymmetric initial state; no claim for general networks or almost-sure convergence.
title: A sharp packet-correlation threshold for two-node CHOCO-Gossip
